page.content:
29 May 1453 — end of the Byzantine state.

How Fall of Constantinople connects

  • Topic: Byzantine Empire — The 1453 fall ended the Byzantine state.
  • Character: Constantine XI Palaiologos — Constantine XI died defending the city in 1453.
  • Character: Mehmed II — Mehmed II took Constantinople in 1453.
  • Location: Theodosian Walls — Ottoman guns broke the Theodosian land walls.

What is Fall of Constantinople?

The Fall of Constantinople in 1453 ended the Byzantine Empire. Mehmed II's guns and ships overcame the Theodosian Walls; Constantine XI died in the breach.

Key threads lead to Byzantine Empire, Constantine XI Palaiologos, Mehmed II and Theodosian Walls.
